proves.claim: testJobRow puts every caller variable matching the job env allowlist into the test job request env map.

cli.io-test-pull.forwards-fixture-variab.why: Without it, a fixture switch set around pullboard test would never reach the runner job and hooks-on proofs would need throwaway probe commits.

proves.claim: testJobRow leaves PATH, HOME, NODE_OPTIONS and every other non-matching variable out of the test job request.

cli.io-test-pull.leaves-other-variables-.why: Without it, a caller shell could set PATH or a loader option for a job running on a shared runner.
